name: scirnaseq
description: sci-RNA-seq or related single-cell combinatorial indexing data.

halt_guidance.blocker: sci-RNA-seq uses experiment-specific RT, ligation, and PCR index sets whose sequence lists and sample assignments are required to reconstruct cell identities.
required_inputs: RT/ligation/PCR barcode lists and read coordinates for the exact protocol version
Experiment-specific barcode-to-sample mapping and species/reference information
next_steps: Identify the sci-RNA-seq protocol generation and recover all barcode/index tables from supplements or authors.
Verify barcode orientation and index-round order against the deposited FASTQs.
Run the study-matched sci-RNA-seq pipeline and retain its barcode tables and matrix outputs.

recommended_workflows.name: sci-RNA-seq3 pipeline
recommended_workflows.role: Combinatorial-index parsing and matrix generation when the study uses a compatible protocol

halt_guidance.resume: Use a protocol-matched sci-RNA-seq output downstream; a generic STARsolo geometry is not sufficient to reconstruct multi-round cell barcodes.
